subject.title: Feature: Agent 动态切换命令（不重启 Gateway）

question: Should OpenClaw support a guarded channel/session-scoped `/agent <name>` switch across configured agents, and what authorization and visibility policy should govern which agents a channel user can see or select?
rationale: The feature changes core routing/session state and can cross workspace, tool, credential, and memory boundaries; source inspection shows no existing canonical policy for exposing configured agents through channel commands.

options.title: Design guarded session switching
options.body: Add the feature only with explicit agent visibility, authorization, memory isolation, and interaction rules for existing bindings and `/focus`.

options.title: Keep static routing only
options.body: Close or defer the request and keep dynamic switching limited to existing TUI-local selection and thread-bound focus behavior.

options.title: Move to plugin/API design
options.body: Define a plugin-owned command or SDK seam if maintainers want optional channel-specific behavior without expanding core policy.

recommendation.title: Design guarded session switching
recommendation.body: Add the feature only with explicit agent visibility, authorization, memory isolation, and interaction rules for existing bindings and `/focus`.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal is around multi-agent routing and docs, which are the core boundaries this product decision would change.
